Review the following terminology related to token quotas:\\\\n\\\\n| Term | Definition |\\\\n| --- | --- |\\\\n| `InputTokenCount` | The CloudWatch Amazon Bedrock runtime metric that represents the number of input tokens processed by the model, excluding cached tokens.
